# BIGBOT + Bot Vault Armor

> Open-source PulseChain BIGBOT ERC-20 and Bot Vault Armor (bot wallet security). MIT. Org: yvybitec-Bigbot.

## Token (mainnet)

- Chain: PulseChain, chainId 369
- BIGBOT: 0xeb6F7B997c0020f5C0334815d9BEAAB661bCfEf6
- Fixed supply 8,315,002,026 (6 decimals); no owner; no tax
- Source: /contracts/token/BigBot.sol
- Compiler: solc 0.8.20, optimizer 200 runs
- Explorer: https://scan.pulsechain.com/address/0xeb6F7B997c0020f5C0334815d9BEAAB661bCfEf6

## Vault Armor (testnet only)

- Chain: PulseChain Testnet V4, chainId 943
- Factory: 0xa39f82C2C3efDa612f77238A12aA2a694aFD09c9
- Vault: 0x3A92c476FC72a83876da2FE9fa2acba2FCc2D297
- Mainnet: pending (not deployed)
- Model: operator != keyMaster; arm with signal payment; caps; delay; decoy trap; no upgrade
- Source: /contracts/vault/
- Descriptor: /.well-known/bigbot-vault.json
